info.name: K10 Football - Academy Tournament Arena & Live Simulation
info.description: Complete Postman collection for Extra Event Tournaments, Club Registration (with Roster & Stripe Checkout), Group Stage Allocation, Fixture Generation, Live Match Simulation Center, and Public Fan Portal.

item.name: 1. Create Extra Event (with Map Lat/Long Coordinates)

body.raw:

request.description: Creates tournament event with Map Coordinates (latitude, longitude), Venue, Organizer info, and £180 fee.

item.name: 2. Register Club with Roster & Stripe Payment (Invited Club Flow)

formdata.description: Upload Club Logo badge file (PNG, JPG, SVG)

request.description: Submits Club Registration Form via multipart/form-data with 'data' JSON string and 'logo' file upload, and generates Stripe Checkout session URL.

item.name: 3. Verify Club Registration Stripe Payment (Fallback / Local Dev)

request.description: Verifies checkout session with Stripe API and marks club registration as PAID.

item.name: 4. Get Registered Clubs List (Owner Admin View)

request.description: Returns list of registered clubs (8/8 teams) with roster counts and status badges.

item.name: 5. Get Available & Taken Tournament Badge Presets

request.description: Returns all 4 tournament badge presets with clean metadata (id, name, color, icon) and whether each preset isTaken or available for registration.
Returns full player list for a registered team (Name, Date of Birth, Shirt No).

item.name: 7. Allocate Clubs to Group A & Group B (Group Stage Builder)

request.description: Allocates exactly 4 clubs to Group A and 4 clubs to Group B.

item.name: 8. Start Tournament & Generate Fixtures (Go to Live Mode)

request.description: Switches tournament status to LIVE GAME, activates Live Mode, generates Group Stage Round-Robin fixtures across Pitch A-F with kickoff times, and initializes Standings & Bracket.
Fetches current live Standings (Group A & Group B), Fixtures list, and Knockout Bracket progression.

item.name: 10. Match Simulation Center - Step 1: Simulate Group Stages

request.description: Generates match scores for all round-robin fixtures, recalculates standings tables (P, W, D, L, GF, GA, GD, PTS), and qualifies Top 2 squads from each group into Semi-finals.

item.name: 11. Match Simulation Center - Step 2: Simulate Semifinals

request.description: Simulates knockout results for Semi-final 1 & Semi-final 2 and populates the Championship Match Grand Final.

item.name: 12. Match Simulation Center - Step 3: Simulate Grand Final

request.description: Simulates final match score, crowns Tournament Champion, and locks results (tournamentStatus: COMPLETED).
Resets tournament back to REGISTRATION state, clears fixtures, standings, and bracket tree.
Completely public endpoint for parents and fans (via 'Share Public Result Link') with venue map coordinates, live standings, fixtures, and bracket tree.
